metadata.dayModel: civil day with preceding service-day spillover
metadata.label: Thurgau canton — validated official-line patterns

timetable.publisher: SBB / Open data platform mobility Switzerland
timetable.refreshPolicy: Pinned September 2026 research fixtures; not a live or current-service feed. A new timetable or geometry release requires a complete rebuild and admission audit.

metadata.model: Scheduled interpolation along cantonal source centrelines with short inferred stop-access connectors; not observed vehicles.
metadata.scope: At least one original GTFS call coordinate in the unsimplified 2026 Thurgau canton polygon. Full journey retained, including every call outside Thurgau. No operator whitelist.
metadata.admission: Only complete directed patterns with every segment passing geometry limits and no reservation/on-demand call. Exclusions retained in the canton audit.

geometry.attribution: © Kanton Thurgau, Abteilung Öffentlicher Verkehr; Amt für Geoinformation
geometry.license: CC BY 4.0, explicitly declared in the cantonal dataset catalogue
geometry.vintageCaveat: No geometry effective date declared. Catalogue creation 2000-01-01, modified timestamp and WFS response time are not verified timetable vintages.
geometry.coordinateModel: Original LV95 east/north, no simplification or inferred joining edges
geometry.transformation: swisstopo approximate CH1903+/WGS84 formula; original LV95 vertices, no simplification, seven-decimal output coordinates
geometry.modifications: Gleislicht: line selection, route graphs, shortest source paths between ordered stop projections, inferred stop-access connectors bounded by snapMetres, conversion to WGS84 and output rounding.
geometry.direction: Bidirectional centreline inference from ordered calls. No road one-way or rail running-track certification; no realtime/diversion verification.
